$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for suite membership. Specs stay organised by module under tests/e2e/ (= the Full Test Suite);
a suite is a SELECTION of test case ids. Read by: playwright.config.ts (TEST_SUITE=<suite> -> grep), scripts/run-suite.js
(npm run test:smoke | test:regression:focused | test:regression:full | suites:check), Allure tags (utils/metadata-manager.ts)
and the Excel suite workbooks (test case sheet/). 'includes' = every test of that suite is also in this one
(smoke is inside focused, focused is inside full). 'limit' = the suite must stay BELOW this many tests until the
whole BigWin system is covered ('target' = expected size then). A test entry is an id string or {id, why}.
New hotfix: spec in tests/e2e/hotfixes/, then add its core ids to regression-focused, its other critical ids to
regression-full, and to smoke ONLY if it changes a critical workflow (replace a smoke test, never exceed the limit).

smoke.name: Smoke Suite
smoke.purpose: Proves the build is usable: only the critical end-to-end workflows of the system.
smoke.whenToRun: Every build / deployment, before any other testing (stop testing if it fails).
smoke.rule: Only critical workflows (log in, create + approve type / brand / draw, upload ticket file, ticket-file protection). A hotfix is added ONLY if it changes a critical workflow (normally 0-1 test per hotfix).

tests.why: Admin can log in (password + OTP) - every workflow starts here
Create a lottery draw and upload its ticket file (DBF + MD5)
Draw maker-checker: Review -> Approve with the upload checksum
Ticket file protection: a file already used by another live draw is refused (Global Checksum)
Create draw with a Mega Prize in cents - saved and shown, also after approval (hotfix 2026-11-23)

regression-focused.name: Focused Regression
regression-focused.purpose: Smoke + the features changed in this release / hotfix + the features they impact.
regression-focused.whenToRun: Every release and every hotfix, after smoke passes.
regression-focused.rule: Smoke suite + the core tests of every changed feature / hotfix + impacted neighbours. Each hotfix adds its core tests (typically 3-8); tests of old, stable changes move out to Full Regression only.

groups.area: Impacted features - Create Draw / Approve Draw / Mega Prize validation

regression-full.name: Full Regression
regression-full.purpose: Complete critical functional coverage of the whole system.
regression-full.whenToRun: Before major releases, monthly, or when a change touches shared code.
regression-full.rule: Focused Regression + the critical / blocker functional tests of every module (CRUD, approval, search, validation, security). Each hotfix adds ALL its critical tests.
